test_vectors.coverage: All scalar kinds, large raw numbers without numeric conversion, repeated scalar skips, operation mode independent of cursor mode, complete quoted spans, unchanged parser position.
Empty strings, multibyte UTF-8, surrogate pairs, all JSON short escapes, raw and decoded arena references, Unicode scalar counts.

Empty and nested containers, delimiter bytes inside escaped strings, leading and trailing whitespace, exact absolute spans, nested sibling preservation, final current event, repeated container skip rejection.
Every two-chunk split of a mixed nested document, single-byte feeds, UTF-8 and escape splits, repeated NeedMore, empty feeds, owned caller chunks, exact nesting carry and arena preservation.
Absent current events, keys and closing events produce TypeMismatch; mismatched pending modes produce ConstraintViolation; ordinary walking during a skip fails without consuming ready input.

Truncated containers, literals and numbers; trailing commas; mismatched delimiters; malformed numbers and keywords; unterminated strings; invalid escapes, surrogates, control bytes and UTF-8; decoded duplicate keys. Errors are compared with direct syntax traversal and retried for exact sticky propagation.
EOF after suspended skips reports UnexpectedEof at the input end. Both skip modes stop before malformed siblings or trailing bytes and do not mark the document finished.

Inclusive depth, item, field, string, digit and decoded-arena limits; zero item, field and string limits; payload-growth failure precedence; duplicate-key policy and object scope; 1024 nested containers.
Container spans at u32 boundaries, exclusive-end overflow, reversed delimiters, injected u16 depth overflow, impossible Finished with unmatched depth, and invalid internal skip progress.
